name: authoring.html-page
description: Per-section checks while an HTML page or course module is being built. One section at a time, from its heading and text plus counts computed in code. Produces: ship / revise / escalate per section. Traces of what the author did next (added an exercise, broke up a block, cut, shipped) become implied labels for these questions (extract/trace-implied.ts). Drafted 2026-09-25 for the wiring batch.

artifact.type: one section of an HTML page or course module

modules.name: section-craft
modules.purpose: Whether one section promises what it delivers, defines what it introduces, gives the reader something to do, and is not a wall of text.

headingPromisesContent.instructions: Does the heading say what the reader will get from this section?

criteria.true: The heading names the outcome, the question answered or the thing built.
criteria.false: The heading is generic, such as Overview, Details or Notes, or does not match the text.

definesItsTerms.instructions: Does this section explain every technical term it introduces?

criteria.true: Each new term is defined or shown by example where it first appears.
criteria.false: At least one term is used as if already known.

hasExercise.instructions: Does this section ask the reader to do something themselves?

criteria.true: An exercise, a try-it step, a question to answer or a task to run.

wallOfText.instructions: Is this section one unbroken block of prose with no list, figure, code sample or sub-heading?

criteria.false: The text is broken up by at least one list, figure, code sample or sub-heading.

sectionRole.instructions: What job does this section do on the page?

criteria.teach: Explains an idea or a mechanism.
criteria.exercise: Asks the reader to do something.
criteria.reference: Lists facts, options or an API for lookup.
criteria.navigation: Orients the reader: contents, summary, what is next.

compose.positive: the section can ship as it is

notForJev.judgement: Word counts, reading time, link validity, heading levels

notForJev.instead: WCAG and layout checks in code or a headless browser

notForJev.judgement: Does this section follow from the previous one?
notForJev.instead: needs the sequence; a text model with the neighbours, or the author
a named human (C10); the trace records the decision
